falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 76% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a failed breakdown/recovery structure; a clean breakout above pre-correction highs invalidates the bottoming thesis and confirms the prior structure was distribution, not accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 40 implies residual fear/uncertainty that typically resolves with a final washout; sustained VIX compression to pre-stress levels would prove the correction already completed without the expected capitulation phase, making the HOLD signal a false positive

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield breaks above 4.50% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades above 5,400
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The pattern match to August 2024 bottom relied on a rates-relief/risk-on dynamic; if equities rally into restrictive rates rather than on falling yields, the macro regime has shifted to a growth-scare invalidation where the bottom thesis fails

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
